items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 70:1
items.html: Before the sin of the First Man, after all the worlds ascended to Atzilut, nevertheless there was the secret of the discernment of Klipot in the fourteen lower Sefirot of the place of BYA. However, they had no building whatsoever; rather, the ZA of the Klipa was in the discernment of VAK, and the Nukva of the Klipa was in the discernment of a point. And see below, answer 253. (Item 229).
